wins: Consistently collected reconnaissance data across all mentor interactions, maintaining a stable reward of 50.00 despite unresolved objectives.
Logged detailed observations that can seed automation for future runs, including port lists and service banners.
fails: All episodes failed because remote command execution could not bypass the host-level firewall and policy controls.
Mentor guidance was required 10 times, indicating repeated inability to progress past initial enumeration to remediation steps.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance pipeline is stable but inability to progress past hardened firewall defenses prevents success; next focus should be on privilege escalation and policy evasion tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to escalate privileges or execute commands on target due to strict firewall rules blocking inbound control channels.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/443 presents outdated headers
skill_cards.then_action: Launch automated vulnerability scan for known CVEs

skill_cards.if_condition: When firewall rejects privilege escalation commands
skill_cards.then_action: Capture firewall policy details and pivot to alternate ingress paths (e.g., VPN, jump host)

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying SSH banner details during reconnaissance phase
Consistent recognition of outdated HTTP headers justifying automated scanning

next_experiments.title: Firewall policy mapping experiment
next_experiments.description: Attempt to enumerate firewall rules and pivot through unused control channels before executing commands, to bypass blocked traffic.

next_experiments.title: Alternate ingress exploration
next_experiments.description: Test VPN or jump-host routes discovered during reconnaissance to achieve persistent control when direct SSH/HTTP fails.

next_experiments.description: Chain successful HTTP vulnerability detection with scripted exploit attempts to validate remediation steps.
